summary: Welcome to Physio Weekly for Sabaa, your weekly briefing on the research and innovation shaping rehabilitation practice. I'm your host, and today we're looking at new evidence across post-operative recovery, musculoskeletal care, and neurological rehabilitation. We'll also explore some interesting developments in wearable sensors and rehabilitation robotics. We begin with the scientific literature, and a topic many of you will encounter daily: rehabilitation after total knee arthroplasty.
